The '''mightiest turoth''' is an especially strong [[Turoth]]. The mightiest turoth can only be fought during the [[Desert Slayer Dungeon (miniquest)|Desert Slayer Dungeon miniquest]], after [[Smoking Kills]].

Killing the mightiest turoth gives the player a reward of 1,000 [[slayer]] experience. If the player kills the mightiest turoth during a task of regular turoths, 391 XP is added to the 1,000 from killing it. However, if the player's current task is turoths, then the 15% combat bonus of the ([[Full slay helm|Full]]) [[Slayer helmet]], [[black mask]], [[hexcrest]], and [[focus sight]] is in effect, as well as the mightiest turoth counting toward the task. It is immune to the effects of stuns.

Like all turoths, the mightiest turoth is immune to all damage not dealt via a [[leaf-bladed spear]], a [[leaf-bladed sword]], [[broad arrows]], [[broad-tipped bolts]], or the [[Slayer Dart]] spell. The recommended strategy for fighting the mightiest turoth is to use [[Slayer Dart]] and [[Protect from Melee]]. It summons some [[swarming turoth]]s (level 60) to aid it.[[File:Player fights Mightiest turoth.png|thumb|left|220px|A player fights the mightiest turoth and a summoned [[swarming turoth]]]]
